description: Returns the content behind a result id, including Knowledge Base Markdown for wiki:<uuid> and the extracted text of a file for file:<uuid>. Knowledge Base pages can also be read by their exact relative, localized, or same-origin absolute Knowledge Base URL. Knowledge Base content is returned in bounded chunks with absolute internal links and a source URL for citations; nextOffset is the offset of the following chunk and is null at the end, and metadata.updatedAt differs from the previous chunk's when the page changed between chunks. The first chunk of a page also names up to five pages that link to it (metadata.incomingWikiLinks, incomingWikiLinksTotal; incomingWikiLinksIncomplete marks a list that is still being read), and metadata.owner and metadata.verifiedAt appear when the page has them: verifiedAt is when someone last confirmed the page, updatedAt when its text last changed. Knowledge Base Read is required for Knowledge Base pages. File text arrives in the same bounded chunks between untrusted-content markers and needs read access to the record and field holding the file; metadata names the record and the extraction status, and a file without extractable text returns why. An offset starts the chunk at that position, so a search result's offset lands on the matched section; at offset 0 a multi-chunk page or file also returns an outline of its headings with their offsets. Compatible with ChatGPT company knowledge and deep research. Links into the app in the docs are full URLs on this instance and open the reader's own workspace.

offset.description: For Knowledge Base and file results, the chunk start offset: the offset of a matched section or the nextOffset of the previous chunk; 0 starts at the beginning

name: fetch

metadata.description: Extra context such as entity type or locale

nextOffset.description: Offset of the following Knowledge Base or file chunk, or null at the end

offset.description: Knowledge Base or file chunk start offset

outline.description: At offset 0 of a multi-chunk Knowledge Base page or file: its H1-H3 headings with the offset each starts at; a file's headings sit between untrusted-content markers

outlineTruncated.description: Some headings were omitted to keep the response bounded.

text.description: Content. Knowledge Base and file results return one bounded chunk, file text between untrusted-content markers; records and product docs return full content

title.description: Display name of the Knowledge Base page, record, or docs page

totalChars.description: Total characters in the externalized Knowledge Base Markdown or the extracted file text

url.description: Canonical app or docs URL; its origin completes the relative app routes in text

title: Read workspace knowledge
